pairs.en: Shopkeeper, these ingredients are my way of saying hello. Will you accept them?☆

pairs.en: Hurry. We set some traps, so we bought a little time, but we don't have much.

pairs.en: What do I think? Well, I just find it annoying to have to pay them so often?

pairs.en: Being summoned is scary, you know. One day, you're just thrown into some strange place. The person who did it might not be a good guy.

pairs.jp: いや、お世話になりそうだった、かな？

pairs.jp: ……カネのためじゃないデス？
pairs.en: ...Wasn't it for the money, though?

pairs.jp: 書いている文字は解読できませんが、私の一族に伝えられる魔術文字に似てますね……！

pairs.jp: いつかは復旧するはずデス

pairs.en: Hey, shopkeeper.

pairs.jp: どうだ、君たちも俺の武勇伝を聞きたくなっただろう！
pairs.en: What do you think, you all want to hear my heroic tales now, don't you!
pairs.speaker: Rasieus

pairs.jp: ボーっとするなデス
pairs.en: Don't just space out.
pairs.speaker: Shiine

pairs.jp: ルーシェは特別だも～んД
pairs.en: Lusche is special~Д
pairs.speaker: Lusche

pairs.jp: でもバケモノから人間に戻ったわけで。証拠がないんだよ
pairs.en: But they turned back from monsters into humans. There's no proof.

pairs.jp: かといって、今はミルテ達を放置するわけにはいかない……どうにかして探さないと
pairs.en: But we also can't just leave Myrte and the others... I have to find a way to search for them.

pairs.en: An ally has been summoned!

pairs.en: Hey Wolfina, eat more quietly. We're drawing attention.

pairs.speaker: Jikuresu

pairs.jp: 争いになるぐらいなら、こうだ！
pairs.en: If it'll stop a fight, then... this!

pairs.en: Oh... okay then...
